user_requirement: The voice must not be robotic; use a natural, easy-to-understand speaking voice for the videos.
delivery: Warm, conversational instruction with clear sentence stress and natural pauses.
pace: Approximately 130-150 words per minute; slower around unfamiliar terms and configuration steps.
voice_candidate: The warm relaxed stock Lulu narrator used in the clean introduction pilot.
generation: Whole scene paragraphs with context; avoid isolated word or sentence regeneration.
verification: Audio and visuals align by scene
voice_listening_review: Not yet independently performed; tool audit must disclose listening capability.
access: Same private Descript project; no public sharing.
